title: Eco-friendly approach for the effective leaching of valuable metals (Ni, Co, Mn) from spent lithium-ion batteries employing natural reductants
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,29589-29597
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA03283D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Wajiha Khalid, Muhammad Kaleem Khosa, Sadaf Fatima, Awal Noor, Sadaf Qayyum, Mohd Farhan
Citric and tartaric acids as lixiviant and sugarcane bagasse as green reductant, have been successfully applied to leach valuable metals from spent lithium-ion batteries.
